_comment: Earnable titles. Plain: stat >= atLeast. Playstyle: stat / per >= atLeast once per >= min.

titles.name: Grain Baron
titles.description: Playstyle: at least half your deliveries are grain (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Oil Runner
titles.description: Playstyle: at least half your deliveries are fuel (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Ore Hauler
titles.description: Playstyle: at least half your deliveries are ore (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Machinist
titles.description: Playstyle: at least half your deliveries are machinery (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Long Hauler
titles.description: Playstyle: average delivery distance of 250+ (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Short-Sea King
titles.description: Playstyle: average voyage under 120 distance (20+ voyages).

titles.name: Sharp Trader
titles.description: Playstyle: average profit of 800+ per delivery (10+ deliveries).

titles.name: Drifter
titles.description: Playstyle: a third of your voyages sailed empty (12+ voyages).
